name: Astral Archer: gaining mana no longer generates threat (#1321)
contract: Astral Archer 681330 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, Moonbow specialization passive) ends its description with
'In addition, gaining mana no longer generates threat.' No DBC effect carries that clause (effect 0 is the
ranged-crit-rating aura, effects 1 and 2 are empty) and no source referenced the id, so the stock energize
threat applied: Unit::EnergizeBySpell and the SPELL_AURA_OBS_MOD_POWER / SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_ENERGIZE ticks call
the recipient's ThreatManager::ForwardThreatForAssistingMe(energizer, 0.5 per point), which adds threat to the
energizer on every creature that has the recipient on its threat list and so starts that creature's combat
with the energizer. Many Starcaller energize spells carry SPELL_ATTR1_NO_THREAT (Moon Arrow's 804096/804155),
which makes them threat-free for every Starcaller and hides the difference; Innervate 29166 does not.
Setup: a mage helper learns Innervate (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_ENERGIZE, 1000 ms ticks, 10 s) and casts it on
each Starcaller while that Starcaller is out of combat, so the cast itself inherits no combat. Each
Starcaller then melees its own passive golem, which puts it on the golem's threat list. Every later Innervate
tick forwards the recipient's mana-gain threat to the helper: the control's helper enters combat with the
control's golem. The archer's helper must stay out of combat through three ticks (at least two energize logs
counted after the engagement), because the archer's mana gain generates no threat.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Astral Archer is active on the archer
Empty the archer's mana so every tick is a real gain
Empty the control's mana so every tick is a real gain
SETUP: the archer's helper starts out of combat
SETUP: the control's helper starts out of combat
Innervate the archer while it is out of combat
Innervate the control while it is out of combat
The archer's golem is engaged with the archer
The control's golem is engaged with the control
Innervate ticks on the archer so far
CONTROL: the control's mana gain puts its helper into combat with the golem
Let three more Innervate ticks land on the engaged archer
Innervate kept restoring the archer's mana while it was engaged
The archer's mana gain generates no threat, so its helper stays out of combat
